text:
jamie: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp is getting a flurry of 429s in the prod sandbox when multiple users replay similar prompts rapidly. Seeing duplicate actions in the downstream webhook. Anyone else noticed this?

maria: Which SDK/version + are users using streaming or sync generation?

jamie: node-sdk v1.4.2, mostly sync calls from the sampleapp web UI. Not streaming.

alex: We shipped a replay-guard helper in python sdk v1.3 but node missed it in parity work — likely root cause. Node default retry/backoff is pretty conservative (no jitter).

kevin: If they're replaying, idempotency keys are the usual fix. Add user+prompt hash as idempotency_key and honor it server-side for ~5m. Also exponential backoff + jitter on client reduces request bursts.

maria: Agreed. Quick config we can add to sampleapp and recommend in onboarding: 
```
retry: {
  maxRetries: 5,
  baseDelayMs: 150,
  maxDelayMs: 2000,
  jitterFraction: 0.4 // randomize +/- 40%
}
```

jamie: Nice. We also saw some 429 responses with Retry-After missing — logs: 
```
POST /v1/generate  429 
x-request-id: r-1a2b3c
body: {"error":"rate_limited"}
```

alex: That missing Retry-After smells like a gateway edge case when fallback routing happens. Could be our smart-routing fast-fail path.

kevin: Another practical mitigation: sampleapp should persist last-successful-request-id per session so UI doesn't re-trigger on reload. Small UX change prevents accidental duplicate replays.

maria: For SDK parity: action = (1) node-sdk expose `withIdempotency(key)` helper + default jittered backoff, (2) samples update to set idempotency keys for create-like calls, (3) docs onboarding callout explaining safe-replay window and recommended TTL.

jamie: Can someone pick the node SDK patch? Also want a small migration note in the sampleapp guide.

alex: I'll take the node PR for the helper and default backoff. Will add unit tests that assert idempotency header on non-streaming requests.

kevin: I'll update the sampleapp to store request ids and add a brief UX debounce on the replay button.

maria: I'll draft the onboarding blurb and add a short checklist to devex docs. Also raising a follow-up to audit smart-routing path for missing Retry-After header.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: docs/devex/onboarding-dedupe -> staging (CI passed) :rocket:

jamie: Thanks all. Let's aim to have node PR + sampleapp change in staging by EOD Friday. If any blockers, ping me here. :+1:
